fusions.name: Long Report
fusions.desc: Fires a single shot that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, with 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Powder Flash
fusions.desc: Looses a blast 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second and leaves them [Muddled] for 5 seconds. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Sight Down the Road
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Shot on the Run
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a shot snaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
